traits.note: Watson and Dallwitz, The Families of Flowering Plants (DELTA data, items edited May 2026), family Pandanaceae: leaves alternate; leaves simple; veins parallel; blades linear or lanceolate; plants dioecious or polygamous; ovary superior; stems woody; flowers in panicles, in racemes or in heads; perianth tepals or absent; fruit usually berry, rarely aggregate; stamens 10 to 100; carpels (1-) 80. Read from the coded states by script (spec-rework/b1/delta/mapdelta.py); a state the authors qualify (rarely, usually, a share) keeps its word, an unqualified one beside a usual state reads as sometimes.
